2608.06861.title: Gated-BEPO: Confidence-Gated Bellman Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents
2608.06861.paper_summary: Training large language model agents in long-horizon environments requires assigning credit from sparse terminal outcomes to individual actions. Existing critic-free methods propagate trajectory-level rewards uniformly across steps, while recent approaches construct step-level groups by matching repeated states and compare actions within each group. The former cannot distinguish useful actions in failed trajectories from ineffective actions in successful ones. The latter rely on step credit derived directly from individual trajectory outcomes and fixed-weight fusion with episode-level credit. We propose Gated-BEPO, which derives step-level credit from empirical rollout graphs. For each rollout group, Gated-BEPO constructs an empirical graph and estimates node values through a mean-backup Bellman fixed point that reflects the empirical action distribution of the current policy. We then accumulate these temporal-difference residuals along each sampled trajectory using generalized advantage estimation, yielding step-level Bellman advantages that capture both immediate and downstream effects. To adaptively fuse episode- and step-level credit, a confidence gate incorporates Bellman credit only at states with multiple observed successors and otherwise uses episode-level credit. Experiments on WebShop, ALFWorld, and visual Sokoban show consistent improvements across language and vision-language models, while diagnostic ablations support the effectiveness of Bellman fixed-point value estimation and show that step-level credit should be incorporated selectively rather than uniformly into the final advantage.
2608.06861.paper_summary_zh: 訓練大型語言模型代理在長期環境中需要將稀疏的終端結果的信譽分配給個別行動。現有的無評估者方法在步驟之間均勻地傳播軌跡級獎勵，而最近的方法則通過匹配重複狀態來構建步驟級組，並在每個組內比較行動。前者無法區分失敗軌跡中的有用行動與成功軌跡中的無效行動。後者依賴於直接從個別軌跡結果中導出的步驟信譽，並與情節級信譽進行固定權重融合。我們提出了 Gated-BEPO，它從經驗回放圖中推導步驟級信譽。對於每個回放組，Gated-BEPO 構建一個經驗圖，並通過反映當前策略的經驗行動分佈的均值回退 Bellman 固定點來估計節點值。然後，我們利用廣義優勢估計沿著每個採樣的軌跡累積這些時間差殘差，產生捕捉即時和下游效果的步驟級 Bellman 優勢。為了自適應地融合情節級和步驟級信譽，一個信心閘只在具有多個觀察到的後繼者的狀態下納入 Bellman 信譽，否則使用情節級信譽。在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和視覺 Sokoban 上的實驗顯示，語言和視覺-語言模型均有一致的改進，而診斷性消融支持 Bellman 固定點值估計的有效性，並顯示步驟級信譽應該選擇性地而非均勻地納入最終優勢。
